description: List orders visible to this participant, cursor-paginated and actor-projected. Filter by order date (inclusive UTC periodFrom/periodTo), status, counterpart name, or platform. Optional participantRole selects BRAND or CREATOR when the current account has both roles; the server verifies that role. Requires read scope. Brand-facing DTOs include only the brand’s own B/Fb/T and own outcome amounts; creator fees, net income, and combined fees stay hidden. The Public API applies current tenant, role, account-access, and object permissions. Pass only IDs returned to this API key; the server derives the acting user and account.
name: vibevo_list_placement_orders
title: List my placement orders
